research: VERIFIED ONLINE (WebSearch + WebFetch on google-index results): (1) The Uzbek-Latin SERP for every PUBG UC query is essentially empty of real editorial content — it is dominated by t.me/s/ Telegram channel previews (UC_BALLU, UmarPubgm, SENATOR_PUBGM, PUBG_STORE_UZ, MeeBo_PUBG), machine-translated international resellers, and one bank product page (ipakyulibank Visa PUBG card). This is the single biggest finding: there is no Uzbek-language authority page to beat. (2) blog.payme.uz has an Uzbek PUBG page but I fetched it and it is ~200-250 words with exactly ONE H2 and no FAQ — trivially outranked by a 1400-word structured article. (3) hablax.com/uz fetched: machine-translated Uzbek (mixed O' / Oʻ diacritics), has FAQ + steps but NO table, and critically its payment list is Credit Card / PayPal / Apple Pay / crypto — NO UzCard, NO HUMO. That is a verified, citable comparison fact, not an assumption. (4) mtcgame.com/uz and bittopup rank on translated content only. (5) Russian cluster is genuinely more competitive: 1pay.uz has a dedicated 'UC через Humo и UzCard' blog post (returned 403 to my fetch, so I only have its indexed title), adek.uz sells UC as a Tashkent e-shop, midasbuy.com/uz serves Russian-first. But most RU-language competitors (prepodsteam, yoomoney, MTS, ggsel) target RUSSIA, not Uzbekistan — so 'узбекистан'-qualified RU queries are still soft. (6) A Russian competitor page states UC arrives 'within 15 minutes, rarely up to 3 hours' — GemPay's ~2 min is a real, defensible differentiator worth stating. (7) The wrong-ID failure mode is confirmed real and widely searched (topuplist, justanswer, Baxity FAQ all cover 'wrong UID = delivered to wrong account, non-refundable') and has ZERO Uzbek coverage — this makes the free pre-payment nickname check GemPay's strongest story. (8) UC packs 60/325/660/1800/3850/8100 confirmed as standard ladder with bonus UC scaling on larger packs. INFERRED / NOT VERIFIED: no keyword volume or difficulty numbers — the Ahrefs and Semrush MCP connectors in this session are unauthorized (OAuth cannot run non-interactively), so I have NO real volume data; the user should authorize those connectors in claude.ai settings to get hard numbers. Query phrasings above are inferred from indexed competitor titles, Telegram channel copy, and Uzbek morphology (sotib olish / olish / quyish / donat variants), not from an autocomplete API. Royal Pass UC costs (Elite ~720, Elite Plus ~1920) come from third-party guides and shift by season — articles must hedge these, never state them as fixed. COMPETITION READ: attack order = problem cluster (zero competition) > question/AEO cluster (zero competition) > pillar money query (weak, translated competition) > comparison (weak) > Russian cluster (moderate, defer).
